items.title: Russia says 16 killed in strike on student dorm that it blamed on Ukraine
items.description: The death toll from a drone strike ​on a student dorm in the Russian-controlled Luhansk region of eastern Ukraine has risen to 16, with most of the victims young women, Russian officials said on Saturday, after a heated U.N. debate on the incident.

items.title: 'The very embodiment of terror': At the ICC, chilling account of crimes committed by Libyan prison official

items.description: The first gathering of Sudeten Germans in Czechia since World War II is happening this weekend, despite a political backlash that has exposed tensions over one of Central Europe's most painful historical legacies.
